title: Kamishiro Rui — Beastly Madness〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's give today's rehearsal everything we've got!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's do our best, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Why the heavy sigh?
Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Um...
Well, it's about Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ichika?
You're friends with her now too, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, I guess we are...
But we didn't exchange contact info or anything...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You didn't?
You'll have to ask her next time you see her.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ichika's not exactly the most outgoing type either from what I remember.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How terrible would it be if your budding friendship withered before ever having a chance to blossom!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nooo! You can't let that happen!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Nene! She goes to the same school as me!
I can ask her about it tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait... Emu, I...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's sort of my fault, so I don't want to ask someone else to make things right in my place.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She asked you to help her with her singing, no?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In which case, I'm sure she'll try to contact you at some point, so there's no need to get so anxious.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... But...

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line: Neneee!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! Nene, it's Rin!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uh... I'll be back in a bit.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa, Emu, can I ask you a favor?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
About Nene...
I was thinking we could help her a little.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Help her how?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For example, by canceling tomorrow's rehearsal.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Fortunately, we have plenty of time to prepare for the next part of the contest, so skipping one rehearsal won't exactly be detrimental.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, okay. That's fine by me...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But what if Nene doesn't take advantage of this opportunity to get her contact information?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That part will be up to her.
Nonetheless, we can still do our part.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Rui! Tsukasa! Let's do this!
Operation Securing Nene & Ichika's Friendship!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, why me too?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Then let's begin by telling Nene that we can't make it to tomorrow's rehearsal.
After school the next day
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Who'd have thought Rin would suggest to Nene that she should go ask Ichika for her number without us having to do anything.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yeah. She just parted the waters for her.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But how do we make sure Nene goes through with obtaining Ichika's information?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We won't see what's going on unless we get close, but if we do, she'll spot us right away and it'll be game over...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Don't worry, I've thought of everything.
First, we go towards that bush over there.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, okay.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm... This should be the right place...
Psst! Tsukasa! Rui! Over here...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu?! Why were you hiding in there?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This is a secret shortcut into the school's courtyard! I found it while exploring the grounds right after my first day!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This way, we get to walk right up to the gate without being seen.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, let's see if Nene can pull through for us.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - School Gate

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Looks like it went well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Indeed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Nicely done, Nene. I'm glad it worked out...)

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Neneee!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
E-Emu?! Wait, you guys are here too?!
No, don't tell me you saw everything?!
